screenLensCompletionPolicy.purpose: Make Screen Lens one scalable read-only application whose Product-specific meaning comes from source, not from special renderer branches or disposable witness artifacts.
laws: Every meaningful projection belongs to a Project and admitted Revision; a special/legacy lens URL must not become a second navigation model.
Phone/workspace/other realization is selected from source-authored layout facts, never subject name.
Expressions are derived from source-owned realization relationships; browser-local custom combinations remain projections, not Product truth.
Runtime presentation facts that matter to the human must be source-projectable without executing arbitrary Product JavaScript inside VexBoard.
Static Screen Lens absence does not prove Product feature absence.
System/Light/Dark is explicit Product-authored presentation state; it must not silently depend on the witness browser's preference when a comparison or accepted witness needs an exact mode.
Surface/Structure/Behavior/Depth share stable identities and do not own duplicate maps.
Human acceptance and source authority are separate coordinates: accepted candidate != Stable, and provisional carrier != disposable meaning.
A fixture/sample/experiment may be retired only after its learned identities, relationships, presentation states and accepted outcome are represented by rightful source/generated projection.
promotionOrder: identify which accepted facts are absent from canonical Product/exporter source
promote those facts to rightful Product/source owner

screenLensCompletionPolicy.completionCriterion: Deleting every provisional experiment/sample/fixture loses no required correctness, continuity, authority, proof or human-accepted meaning because all earned truth is reproducible from rightful source.
